thread:
Ana (PM): Heads up — BigEnterprise just signed LOI, they want the analytics dashboard + SOC2 compliance within 5 months. We need to decide sequencing.
Romi (Sales): Confirmed. It's a $1.2M ARR deal if we meet their timeline and controls. SOC2 is their legal blocker.
Sam (Security): 5 months is tight for full Type II. We can scope for Type I/attestation faster if we limit the control set. Must cover: access control, logging/monitoring, change mgmt, encryption at rest/in transit, vendor mgmt.
Devin (Eng): Analytics feature estimate: 8 sprints cross-team to full GA. Can we scope an MVP (aggregated dashboards, no PII) in ~10 weeks? Major work: ingestion pipeline, aggregation, front-end.
Ana (PM): Quick RICE to compare tracks (simple ints 1-10). SOC2 scoping: Reach=7 Impact=8 Confidence=6 Effort=5 -> Score = (7*8*6)/5 = 67.2. Analytics MVP: Reach=6 Impact=9 Confidence=5 Effort=8 -> Score = (6*9*5)/8 = 33.75.
Sam (Security): Reminder: SOC2 has long tail value — it unlocks multiple enterprise deals beyond this customer. Treat R as multiplier.
Romi (Sales): Customer asked if we can run a private/dedicated instance for them while SOC2 work completes. They prefer a contractual workaround but still want SOC2 evidence within 6 months.
Maya (VP Product): Proposal: parallel-track approach. 1) Start SOC2 scoping + close high-impact gaps (infra + logging + identity) as highest priority. 2) Ship an analytics MVP limited to aggregated metrics + no PII, deployed to a Dedicated tenant for BigEnterprise as a beta. 3) Use SOC2 artifacts (policies, logs) to support the customer and accelerate sales.
Devin (Eng): Implementation note: we can create an "analytics-dedicated" org, build a lightweight ETL that pseudonymizes data (hash user ids) and generates aggregated rows only. Infra work: VPC isolation + central logging + RBAC. Rough ETA for MVP if parallel work is greenlit: 9 weeks. SOC2 infra baseline for Type I: 10-12 weeks with 2 infra-focused FTEs + security lead.
Sam (Security): I'll own control owners and evidence collection. Immediate asks: enable centralized audit logs, enable MFA on service accounts, baseline config management, and a documented incident response plan. These are scoping tickets 1-4.
Ana (PM): Suggested decision: Approve parallel plan, allocate 2 dedicated infra/security FTEs for 8 weeks, 3 engineers for analytics MVP. Sales to offer Dedicated beta under amended MSA "SOC2-in-progress" clause.
Romi (Sales): Sales can accept amended MSA + 60-day beta credit. I'll draft amendment and legal will review. Customer is flexible on beta patterns as long as we restrict PII.
Maya (VP Product): Agree to run with parallel plan. Flag fallback: if SOC2 artifacts hit blockers, hold GA for public customers and limit to the dedicated customer until resolved. Keep exec informed weekly.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: analytics/feature-beta -> staging at 1769954385 :rocket:
Ana (PM): OK — I'll open the RICE doc, create the SOC2 epics and assign owners. Can we have first SOC2 scoping update in 3 working days?
Sam (Security): Yes. I'll post scoping checklist + initial gap list within 48 hours.
Devin (Eng): I'll spin up the isolation infra tickets and a prototype ETL this week.
Romi (Sales): I'll send the MSA amendment draft to legal and loop in customer CISO.
Maya (VP Product): Thanks all. Please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
Ana (PM): :thumbsup:
